text: ZX81 WEATHER WALL 26 SEP 18:08Z: HIGH 32C BRASILIA; LOW 8C REYKJAVIK. 1 MAJOR HURRICANE SIGNATURE POLO 936MB E PACIFIC. 1 HURRICANE SIGNATURE SURIGAE 1008MB S CHINA. 1 HURRICANE SIGNATURE NOLO 977MB C PACIFIC +1 MORE. SEAS ROUGH NEAR S PACIFIC. 100 ZX81S ON WATCH.

image.alt: A 10x10 wall of 100 ZX81 screens rendering a live world weather map in 1-bit block graphics. 4 cyclones marked by rotating spiral markers: E PACIFIC (major), S CHINA, C PACIFIC +1 more. Precipitation signals present: rain areas and snow or wintry areas. Hottest 32C at AMAZON, coldest 8C at N ATLANTIC. Roughest seas at S PACIFIC.
